title: PossibleMC
body:
Fresh take on the vanilla+ experience, improving a lot of already existing features and adding new ones

Used mods that I believe should be a part of the main game


Features:

Overhauled overworld

New mobs

Improved progression

New structures

New gameplay features


Comes with performance mods to make gameplay smooth. Should run great on most hardware without shaders :)


Hopefully you guys enjoy as this is my first modpack so expect inconsistencies :)
